method.name: dd_median3_paired_uniform128
method.time_sampler_note: Each adjacent pair has complementary times low=0.5u and high=1-low for u~U[0,1), with random assignment to its samples. The mixed marginal time distribution is uniform on [0,1] and every pair spans the two half-intervals.
method.train_notes: Official DD EMA initialization under dd-selfproto-v1.3. 128 targets, three proposals per original label, stable lower-median LPIPS-distance selection, one pass, uniform weights. Time pairs use complementary half-interval antithetic sampling. Frozen training and evaluation settings are supplied exclusively by the trainer.

embedding_loss: LPIPS-alex-v0.1 on decoded continuous-head suffix and teacher prefix
classification_loss: CE averaged over generated tokens of all scales
teacher_reuse_note: Each pass visits every pair once; stop earlier when the GPU budget ends.
